channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What’s happening on Iran war day 91 as US, Iran near 60-day deal
item.description: US and Iran near a 60-day MoU aimed at reopening the Hormuz strait with talks slated on nuclear and other differences.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran, Trump yet to comment on 60-day truce extension plan
item.description: Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam says 'nothing can justify' Israel's military onslaught against 'peaceful people' in Lebanon.

item.title: Iran ambassador hits out at ‘country to the north’ in US World Cup visa row
item.description: Iran's football team still lacks US visas and is not competing on 'equal terms', Tehran's envoy to Mexico says.

item.title: US and Iran 'very close' to deal but 'not there yet', Vance says
item.description: US officials earlier told the BBC that the framework of a ceasefire extension deal had been agreed, pending the approval of Trump and Iran's leadership.

item.title: Are US and Iran close to peace or sliding back to war?
item.description: Neither side seems interested in a return to all-out conflict, despite the latest exchange of strikes.

item.title: Netanyahu says he has directed IDF to increase control of Gaza to 70%
item.description: The expansion in control by Israel would contradict the terms of the ceasefire Israel and Hamas agreed to in October 2025.

item.title: Gaza City hospitals say several killed in strike, as Israel targets Hamas leaders
item.description: At least five children were reportedly killed in the strike, which appears to have targeted a Hamas commander.

item.title: Israel hits Lebanese capital in 'targeted strike'
item.description: Beirut had until now largely been spared even as both Israel and Hezbollah accused each other of breaking last month's ceasefire.

item.title: Learning from Ukraine war, Hezbollah is now using fibre-optic drones to hit Israel
item.description: Fibre-optic drones are now Hezbollah's primary weapon against Israel's soldiers and civilians.

item.title: Duterte ICC trial to start on 30 November: What you need to know
item.description: Duterte is facing charges relating to a long and bloody war on drugs in which thousands were killed.
